simulation_truth_policy: Final outcomes are audit-only and must never be read by simulation code.
game_truth_source: Final NFL Week 1 results, cross-checked against nflverse schedule/results.
player_truth_source: nflverse Player Summary Stats 2026 REG; normalized snapshot is generated and archived by the benchmark workflow.
notes: Benchmark A contains only the 12 Sunday main-slate games frozen in the original Week 1 runner.
DEN@KC belongs to Benchmark B because it was simulated later with a different v6.3/current-role context and is not mixed into Benchmark A.
DAL@NYG is excluded because it was not in the frozen Sunday runner.
